# Version 4.150.2
> **Skia m150 servicing fixes** · Released August 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.2/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.2 refreshes Skia m150 with upstream GPU and SkSL correctness fixes. The bundled engine corrects stale readbacks, failed-flush tracking, Imagination GPU framebuffer deletion, and a SkSL RasterPipeline code-generation use-after-free.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia m150 receives four upstream bug-fix syncs** — Ganesh now handles failed flushes without stale readbacks or inconsistent dirty tracking, corrects Imagination GPU framebuffer deletion, and fixes a SkSL RasterPipeline code-generation use-after-free. ([#4517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4517), [#4561](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4561), [#4648](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4648), [#4663](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4663))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.2

Updates the co-shipped HarfBuzzSharp package from 14.2.1.1 to 14.2.1.2.
